fluff.overview: The AFFS treats its infantry as professionals rather than expendable garrison filler, drawing soldiers from single worlds or neighboring systems to build the unit cohesion that the Federated Suns considers essential to effective combined-arms operations. Foot infantry remain the backbone of AFFS planetary garrisons, cheap enough to deploy in numbers across the Federated Suns' vast territory and reliable enough to hold ground that BattleMech forces cannot permanently occupy. These anti-aircraft specialists are trained and equipped to engage low-flying aerospace fighters, VTOLs, and conventional aircraft, providing dedicated point air defense for installations and ground formations.
